title: The Future of Digital Signage with Tech Innovator Mike Chen
description: Explore cutting-edge technologies transforming the sign industry, from AR displays to AI-powered design tools that are revolutionizing how we create and interact with signage.
keyTakeaways: AR-enabled signage will become mainstream within 2 years
AI can reduce design time by 70% while improving client satisfaction
Interactive displays show 3x higher engagement than static signs
The future of signage is personalized, real-time content delivery
Investment in digital capabilities is no longer optional for sign shops
